shortDescription: Manages base ACL configuration on HUAWEI CloudEngine switches.

options.name: acl_description
options.description: ACL description. The value is a string of 1 to 127 characters.

options.name: acl_name
options.description: ACL number or name. For a numbered rule group, the value ranging from 2000 to 2999 indicates a basic ACL. For a named rule group, the value is a string of 1 to 32 case-sensitive characters starting with a letter, spaces not supported.

options.name: acl_num
options.description: ACL number. The value is an integer ranging from 2000 to 2999.

options.name: acl_step
options.description: ACL step. The value is an integer ranging from 1 to 20. The default value is 5.

options.name: log_flag
options.description: Flag of logging matched data packets.

options.name: rule_action
options.description: Matching mode of basic ACL rules.

options.name: rule_description
options.description: Description about an ACL rule. The value is a string of 1 to 127 characters.

options.name: rule_id
options.description: ID of a basic ACL rule in configuration mode. The value is an integer ranging from 0 to 4294967294.

options.name: rule_name
options.description: Name of a basic ACL rule. The value is a string of 1 to 32 characters. The value is case-insensitive, and cannot contain spaces or begin with an underscore (_).

options.name: source_ip
options.description: Source IP address. The value is a string of 0 to 255 characters.The default value is 0.0.0.0. The value is in dotted decimal notation.

options.name: src_mask
options.description: Mask of a source IP address. The value is an integer ranging from 1 to 32.

options.name: state
options.description: Specify desired state of the resource.

options.name: time_range
options.description: Name of a time range in which an ACL rule takes effect. The value is a string of 1 to 32 characters. The value is case-insensitive, and cannot contain spaces. The name must start with an uppercase or lowercase letter. In addition, the word "all" cannot be specified as a time range name.

options.name: vrf_name
options.description: VPN instance name. The value is a string of 1 to 31 characters.The default value is _public_.
